name: End Of Days
overview: Scripture reveals that the end of days will be marked by unprecedented distress and global turmoil, as described in Daniel 12:1 and Matthew 24:6-7. Jesus teaches that while wars, famines, and natural disasters will signal the approach of the end, no one knows the exact day or hour except the Father (Matthew 24:36). Believers are called to remain watchful and discerning, recognizing these signs as indicators that Christ’s return is near (Matthew 24:33). Ultimately, God’s people will be delivered and preserved through this time of trial, assuring us of His sovereign care.
